options.name: cs_global
options.description: All of the Copy Services requests that establish or re-establish a relationship, and are subject to this resource scope including FlashCopy and PPRC relationships.

options.name: gm_masters
options.description: An array of Global Mirror session IDs that are allowed to be used as a master session for volumes in this resource. A Session ID is a hexadecimal number in the 01 - FF range.

options.name: gm_sessions
options.description: An array of Global Mirror session IDs that are allowed to be used for the volumes in this resource. A Session ID is a hexadecimal number in the 01 - FF range.

options.name: hostname
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the DS8000 storage system HMC.

options.name: id
options.description: Unique identifier that is assigned to this resource group ID in the form RG If not specified, one will be chosen. Resource Group 0 is predefined and cannot be created, deleted, or modified. By default, all resources belong to this group unless otherwise specified.

options.name: label
options.description: The resource group label is 1 to 32 characters and is limited to upper and lower case alphabetic and numeric characters, and the special characters (-), (_), and (.). Required when I(state=present)

options.name: name
options.description: The nickname that you assigned for this resource group object.

options.name: pass_global
options.description: All of the Copy Services requests that are issued though a pass-through logical volume are treated as a relationship between the pass-through logical volume and source logical volume and are subject to this resource scope.

options.name: password
options.description: The password for the DS8000 storage system I(username).

options.name: port
options.description: The port number of the DS8000 storage system HMC.

options.name: state
options.description: Specify the state the DS8000 resource group should be in.

options.name: username
options.description: The username for the DS8000 storage system.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Controls validation of SSL chain of trust. Set to C(no) to allow connection when SSL certificates are not trusted.
